messages.author: 39703be20dd273a9
messages.subject: Can't publish app - process stuck on Detecting System Locale
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to publish my app but the process halts indefinitely at the Detecting System Locale step and my app is shown as undeployed in the Dashboard. I don't get any error messages or any other info that would help me debug.  Tried both with the RStudio IDE Publish button as well as deployApp() command. Any ideas what might be the problem?

Source code for both ui.R and server.R in my github repo: https://github.com/MattiNiemisto/DevelopingDataProducts/tree/master/DDPCWMatti

kind regards, Matti

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Can't publish app - process stuck on Detecting System Locale
parts:
Matti,

We've seen some issues before doing locale detection on Windows. It could take a very long time on some machines. You might consider overriding the auto detected locale by doing:

options(rsconnect.locale = 'your_locale')

-Andy
